args: import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import { slugify } from './src/slugify.mjs'; assert.equal(slugify(' --Already   Clean-- '), 'already-clean')
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import { slugify } from './src/slugify.mjs'; assert.equal(slugify('Café déjà'), 'cafe-deja')

oracle.patch:
diff --git a/src/slugify.mjs b/src/slugify.mjs
--- a/src/slugify.mjs
+++ b/src/slugify.mjs
@@ -1,3 +1,8 @@
 export function slugify(value) {
-  return value.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/, '-')
+  return value
+    .trim()
+    .toLowerCase()
+    .normalize('NFKD')
+    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
+    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
+    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '')
 }
